name: local-flight-map
what_it_holds: Open air-traffic map application combining ADS-B Exchange and OpenSky Network data feeds for local/regional flight tracking. MIT licensed, 1 star, updated Sep 2026 (actively maintained).
why_useful: Combines both major free flight-tracking sources (ADS-B Exchange + OpenSky) in one client, which could be a starting point for a lightweight airport-departure-count scraper if the team wanted a point-in-time capacity series; marginal on its own since it's built for live map display, not data export.
geography: Configurable/local (whatever region the user points it at)
themes: Flight tracking and schedules: OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange, FlightRadar scrapers, aviationstack samples, airline seat capacity by route
why_all: Combines both major free flight-tracking sources (ADS-B Exchange + OpenSky) in one client, which could be a starting point for a lightweight airport-departure-count scraper if the team wanted a point-in-time capacity series; marginal on its own since it's built for live map display, not data export.

name: feedclient
what_it_holds: Official ADS-B Exchange feeder client (feeds an existing readsb/dump1090/piaware receiver INTO ADS-B Exchange), 102 stars, MIT license, actively updated (Sep 2026).
why_useful: Not a data-pull tool -- it's for contributing ground-station data TO ADS-B Exchange, so it does not help acquire flight data for the pitch. Flagged only because it is the highest-starred, most-maintained repo in the ADS-B Exchange ecosystem and confirms the network is alive and growing (context for evaluating other ADS-B Exchange client repos above).

name: fr24scraper
what_it_holds: Realtime FlightRadar24 scraper, 0 stars, updated Sep 2026 (very new/unproven).
why_useful: A candidate method for pulling FlightRadar24 route/schedule data if ADS-B Exchange/OpenSky prove insufficient, but it is unmaintained/unproven (0 stars, brand new) and scraping FlightRadar24 directly likely runs into the same terms-of-service question flagged for Airbnb scraping -- would need a human ToS call before any use.
size_hint: Small scraper script, no committed data

name: ourairports-data
what_it_holds: Daily-updated mirror of OurAirports.com: airports.csv, airport-frequencies.csv, runways.csv, navaids.csv, countries.csv, regions.csv -- global airport reference (86,013 airport rows per a citing repo). 1,757 commits, updated daily via automated pull.
why_useful: A live, daily-refreshed, public-domain airport reference table (more complete/current than OpenFlights' static airports.dat) useful as a join key for any flight-schedule or ADS-B work keyed to IATA/ICAO codes across Airbnb-relevant gateway cities.
size_hint: 6 CSVs, ~86k airport rows plus runway/navaid detail
last_activity: actively maintained, daily automated updates, 1,757 commits
themes: Flight tracking and schedules: OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange, FlightRadar scrapers, aviationstack samples, airline seat capacity by route

name: airportsdata
what_it_holds: 28,298 airport/landing-strip/seaplane-base entries with ICAO/IATA codes, coordinates, timezone, elevation; fork of mwgg/Airports, cross-validated against AIPs/ARINC/IATA/ch-aviation. Distributed as CSV plus a PyPI package.
why_useful: Another free, actively maintained (199 commits) global airport reference with timezone data -- marginal incremental value over OurAirports/OpenFlights but easy to use as a Python package for any flight-data join work.
